authority.specification: Controller/DTO/service source is authoritative; checked-in swagger.json is stale.
authority.scope: 122 active controller routes; frontend-only repairs. Existing uncommitted work preserved.

moduleRules.auth: Login returns a bearer token; profile requires JWT. Registration is ADMIN-only; only SUPERADMIN can create SUPERADMIN. Password minimum 8. Existing session expiry/401 clearing remain authoritative.
moduleRules.clients: Names/addresses required for create; contact details optional/nullable. includeInactive=true|false|only. Archive/restore retains IDs and history.
moduleRules.sales-orders: Draft edits require expectedRevision >= 1; persisted revision/status/totals authoritative. Positive decimal quantity, nonnegative price, max 2 decimals; rate and fixed discount mutually exclusive. No editing confirmed lines.
moduleRules.suppliers: Code/name/address required; optional nullable contacts. Archive/restore supported. No supplier-product reference-price routes in active controller.
moduleRules.purchase-orders: Header/line fields and server amounts authoritative; draft-only edits; supplier optional. Confirmation ADMIN-only. Accepted good receipts, not damage, fulfill orders.
moduleRules.incoming-deliveries: Header-only creation. DRAFT -> SCHEDULED -> COMPLETED. Completion items use purchaseOrderItemId, receivedQuantity > 0, 0 <= damaged <= received; accepted goods cannot exceed remaining PO quantity. Empty items requires noReceiptReason; cannot mix reason with items. Confirmed response before cache refresh.
moduleRules.outgoing-deliveries: Header-only creation. One saved warehouse; revisioned draft planning/scheduling. Dispatch confirms positive loadedQuantity <= plan, current source warehouse stock and order capacity. Completion covers every loaded item with delivered+sellable+damaged+missing=loaded; damage/missing needs reason. Backend reserves/releases/reconciles and updates vehicle/order states.
moduleRules.inventory-items: Catalog unitPrice is decimal string. Detail/price separate PATCH routes. Archive/restore rather than delete history. includeInactive filter supported.
moduleRules.stock-items: Quantities are decimal strings; backend availableQuantity and stockStatus authoritative. Threshold supports null, >=0 and 2 decimals. Stock adjustments enforce reservations/damage. Quarantine tags require UUID requestId, positive quantity <= available and reason; condition correction only open lots. CLEAR/REMOVE <= remaining; audit actor/source preserved.
moduleRules.warehouses: Required name/address; optional contact; archive/restore retains identity. Frontend prevents archiving stocked warehouses; backend does not atomically enforce that restriction (see PARTIAL route).
moduleRules.delivery-vehicles: Nullable exact decimal capacity. Frontend restricts changing/archiving assigned vehicles. Backend state/active mutations lack atomic assignment guards (see PARTIAL routes).
moduleRules.employees: Required names/hireDate; optional user link. Profile, link/unlink and archive/restore have distinct endpoints. Active driver ID is employee ID.
moduleRules.jobs: Create/edit/archive/restore; employee assignments separate. ADMIN/MANAGER writes, STAFF reads.
moduleRules.employee-jobs: Use employeeId/jobId. Replacement requires nonempty array of positive integer IDs. Dedicated unlink endpoint supports removing final assignment.
moduleRules.users: List ADMIN/MANAGER. Account mutations ADMIN, with backend actor/self/protected-admin constraints. Password minimum 8; never render or log credentials.
moduleRules.audit-events: SUPERADMIN-only cursor-paginated account audit query. No current audit-management screen; intentionally unused.
moduleRules.health: Public readiness/liveness are infrastructure probes, not mutations.
moduleRules.root: Public backend greeting/health convenience; no operational frontend dependency.
